description: Use when the user asks what an American/British TV show or movie line, catchphrase, idiom, or slang means — "这句美剧台词什么意思", "XX 是什么梗", "老友记里那句…", "为什么这么说", "这个口头语怎么用", "what does 'X' mean in this show", or pastes a subtitle line / screenshot / SRT and wants the spoken English explained. Explains meaning, origin (why people say it), tone & offensiveness, when you can/can't use it, natural Chinese equivalent, examples, scene context, how to respond, and logs it to a personal 生词本. Triggers — "美剧口头语", "台词什么意思", "这是什么梗", "/wjs-explaining-tv-slang".
